'''Alpha Point Zero''' was the highest priority level [[Shell Hutts]] could give to one of their negotiators. It allowed the sentients being received to avoid going through several persons and showed how serious their arrival was taken.<ref name="The Mandalorian Armor">[[The Mandalorian Armor]]</ref>
